8216c196796f0b64  def CliqueLowerBound.two_cliques
    two_cliques = fun U0 U1 : list nat => (clique_edges U0 ++ clique_edges U1)%list : list nat -> list nat -> Family Arguments two_cliques (U0 U1)%list_scope

a9556658e41ea030  def Conjecture.sunflower_conjecture
    sunflower_conjecture = exists c : nat -> nat, (forall k : nat, 2 <= k -> k - 1 <= c k) /\ (forall n k : nat, 1 <= n -> 2 <= k -> UpperBound n k (S (PeanoNat.Nat.pow (c k) n))) : Prop

e86e08bec70e4583  def Conjecture.spread_conjecture
    spread_conjecture = exists c : nat -> nat, (forall k : nat, 2 <= k -> 1 <= c k) /\ (forall n k : nat, 1 <= n -> 2 <= k -> SpreadYieldsDisjoint n k (c k)) : Prop
